3.2.value: Mechanics as printed in FY2025 10-K (Item 5 - Share Repurchases; repeated in Note 14): CADENCE/PRICING DATE - repurchases only as of the opening of the last calendar day of each month (the 'Repurchase Date'); price = transaction price in effect on the Repurchase Date, generally the prior month's NAV per share, with a sole-discretion exception to reprice where NAV materially changed. EARLY EXIT - shares outstanding <1 year repurchased at 98% of transaction price (Early Repurchase Deduction), not applicable to DRIP shares. SETTLEMENT - generally within three business days of the Repurchase Date. CAPS - 2% of aggregate NAV/month, 5%/calendar quarter, both assessed each month. PRORATION - if requests exceed limits, repurchases are made pro rata AFTER first satisfying all requests due to death, disability or divorce and other limited exceptions; unsatisfied requests are NOT carried over - they 'must be resubmitted after the start of the next month or quarter, or upon the recommencement' of the plan. PRICE-AVAILABILITY GATE - if the transaction price is not made available by the tenth business day prior to the last business day of the month (or changed after), no requests are accepted that month. BOARD POWERS - may repurchase fewer shares than the caps or none, has made past exceptions, and may modify/suspend the plan. NOT PRINTED IN THE 10-K: the request-submission deadline and the stockholder's request-withdrawal window - those terms are in the Share Repurchase Plan / prospectus 'Share Repurchases' section (pointer: BREIT 424(b)(3) prospectus on EDGAR, CIK 1662972).

4.1.value: NAV frequency: monthly — 'We calculate and publish NAV monthly' solely for establishing monthly sale/repurchase price. Who values: the Adviser (BX REIT Advisors L.L.C.) calculates fair value of real estate properties monthly, based in part on values from third-party independent appraisers; each property valued by an independent third-party appraisal firm annually; monthly reasonableness review by an independent valuation advisor; the independent valuation advisor does not calculate NAV — 'the Adviser is ultimately and solely responsible for the determination of our NAV.' NAV is computed by State Street Bank and Trust Company ('State Street') or its affiliates using Adviser-provided valuations, per valuation guidelines approved by the board of directors. NAV model adjusts assets/liabilities to fair value generally per ASC 820; NAV not audited and not a GAAP measure. Full policy in 'Net Asset Value Calculation and Valuation Guidelines' in the Prospectus (referenced, not reproduced, in the 10-K).
4.1.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-27

Nine reportable segments: Rental Housing, Industrial, Net Lease, Data Centers, Hospitality, Self Storage, Retail, Office, and Investments in Real Estate Debt. As of Dec 31, 2025: 4,483 properties and 63,918 single family rental homes. Real estate debt instruments as printed: CMBS, RMBS and other residential credit, real estate-related corporate credit, mortgages, mezzanine and other loans, CDO and CLO interests, equity interests in entities investing in real estate debt, and derivatives. Leverage/complexity: target leverage ratio approximately 60% (actual 47% at Dec 31, 2025); real estate debt portfolio has embedded leverage through reverse repurchase agreements and may have embedded leverage through derivatives including total return swaps, securities lending arrangements and credit default swaps. Interest rate and foreign currency hedging derivatives on balance sheet at Dec 31, 2025: $960,328K assets / $24,274K liabilities (Level 2).
